status_rule: PASS only when every required assertion is PASS on the named target machine and artifact hash

required_steps.assertion: installed artifact launches outside the checkout
bootstrap returns READY or documented DEGRADED, never an unexplained BLOCKED
database reaches the frozen migration head
random sentinel write/read/delete succeeds and a final read is missing
supported problem is accepted through the product surface
spawn worker is healthy and produces the bound authoritative decision
incorrect or partial attempt is assessed without solution leakage
verified parent cycle produces an active practice offer
accepted offer creates and judges the bound child cycle
an explicitly selected test document imports without directory scanning
imported document is retrieved through the lexical baseline
backend and worker restart and prior state remains durable
verified restore succeeds under the maintenance gate
a new supported problem solves after restore
frontend, backend, verifier worker and picker exit without an orphan process
